text:
Lena: Quick PSA — release cutoff is in ~8 hours. If you touched public APIs or runtime behavior, please add a changelog entry now. Keep it one line, tag the component, and include a PR link.

Sam: ack. Quick Q: what format do we prefer for component tags? [runtime] vs runtime?

Lena: prefer bracketed, e.g. [runtime], [console], [api]. Makes the release parser happier.

Kai: also: one-liner shape please. No long justification — link to the PR for details. We have an automated summarizer that expects concise entries.

Jia: anything about including migrations/schema changes?

Lena: yes, include [migration] tag and short note like "added DB column for X (backfill required)". If it could break consumers, add [breaking].

Sam: can we share a tiny sample we can copy-paste?

Lena: sure — use this template:
```
[component] Short one-line description. (PR: <link>, owner: @who)
```
Example:
```
[runtime] Improve KV cache eviction heuristics to reduce token duplication. (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1234, owner: @kai)
```

Alex: tiny nits from the linter — please avoid starting with verbs like "fixes" or "adds"? We prefer neutral phrasing. e.g. "Improve X" not "Fix bug preventing X" — save details for the PR.

Release Bot: :robot_face: changelog lint: GH PR #1234 — missing component tag -> failure

Jia: FYI I just pushed an entry for my PR — used [console] and linked the PR. cc @lena

Lena: thanks Jia :thumbsup: once the entry is in, make sure it's in the keep-a-changelog/next.md file in the release branch — most of the automation pulls from there.

Sam: Where do we put entries for internal-only changes (no customer impact)?

Lena: still add them under [internal]. Helps internal release notes and audit trails. If it's truly trivial, you can skip, but err on the side of including it.

Kai: small reminder — when backporting, include the backport PR link in the parenthesis, like (PR: <main PR>, backport: <backport PR>)

Lena: Last call: cutoff in 8 hours. If you're blocked on the changelog lint, ping me or @alex. I'll be triaging entries and running a quick sweep 1 hour before cutoff. :alarm_clock:

Sam: pinging reviewers for any entries needing wording tweaks.

Alex: I'll run the lint job and send the results here. If you see failures, please fix the shape not the wording style (we'll tidy later).

Release Bot: :white_check_mark: changelog lint: sweep queued (ETA ~10m)

Lena: Appreciate the fast turnaround everyone. Short, consistent entries make release notes readable and keep rollouts smooth.

Sam: noted — updating mine now.
